questions.q: Which personality type seeks wealth and status?
questions.why: Adam I is described as the external, success‑driven personality.

questions.q: What moral value is said to be lost in modern society?
questions.why: The text notes a loss of integrity, commitment, and kindness.

questions.q: What does Brooks suggest to develop character?
questions.why: Brooks advises admitting flaws and abandoning pride to build character.

questions.q: Which term describes society's focus on how actions are done?
questions.why: The book criticizes a focus on how actions are done rather than why.

questions.q: What does the author call people who focus on external success?
questions.why: Brooks refers to people dominated by Adam I as perpetual stumblers.
